title: Compact k12 Alpha2 confirmation
research_question: Does the compact Alpha2 k=[1,2] candidate retain useful performance when retrained on the full canonical ECG200 TRAIN split?
hypothesis: The frozen k=[1,2] candidate will retain accuracy comparable to active Alpha2 k=[1,2,3,4] while using substantially fewer parameters.
frozen_models: active_alpha2_k1234: frozen Alpha2 topology with k=[1,2,3,4]

data_protocol.rule: Train both frozen models on all canonical TRAIN cases. No architecture/frequency selection or tuning from TEST.

primary_metric: Aggregate integer correct Q.ANT TEST predictions across 1,000 predictions per model.
success_criteria: Compact k12 must be within 10 correct predictions of active Alpha2 k1234 across 1,000 predictions (compact_correct >= control_correct - 10), and its across-seed Q.ANT accuracy standard deviation must be no more than 0.015 absolute above control.
promotion_rule: If both criteria are met, promote k12 as the compact Alpha2 frequency basis because it uses substantially fewer parameters. Otherwise retain active Alpha2 k1234.
hardware_boundary: Software/simulation-backend experiment only; no real photonic hardware performance claim.
